items.headline: Housing commission agenda: below-market-rate in-lieu fees tied to square footage
items.summary: The October 28 Housing and Human Services Commission agenda listed a recommendation to the City Council to convert the below-market-rate in-lieu fee for ownership developments to a square-footage-based fee. It also listed amending the in-lieu fees for rental and ownership developments and adding periodic reviews of the city's inclusionary housing policy.

items.headline: Sunnyvale council agenda: rewrite of DUO housing and lot-split rules
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed an ordinance to repeal and replace Sunnyvale's Dual Urban Opportunity (DUO) Housing chapter and its Urban Lot Split chapter, plus conforming changes to zoning and revenue rules to match new state laws. It was listed as an ordinance introduction.

items.headline: Council agenda: $3.26M WeHOPE contract for homeless outreach and hotel programs
items.summary: The October 27 agenda listed a contract amendment with WeHOPE covering street outreach, the temporary hotel program, Dignity on Wheels mobile hygiene services, and the inclement weather hotel program. It would raise the total not-to-exceed amount to $3,255,267.36, extend the term through September 10, 2027, and include a $2,152,098 budget modification.

items.headline: Council agenda: $7.4M for three new ladder fire trucks
items.summary: The October 27 agenda listed a $7,372,642.10 purchase order to Golden State Fire Apparatus, Inc. for three Pierce 100-foot tower fire apparatuses.

items.headline: Council agenda: ban on potable water for nonfunctional turf, new 15 mph school zones
items.summary: The October 27 agenda listed adoption of an ordinance implementing state law AB 1572 by prohibiting potable water for irrigating nonfunctional turf. It also listed a resolution to establish 15 mph school zones and extend the school zone near Laurelwood Elementary.

items.headline: Study session on replacing Hawthorn Avenue duplex with three condos
items.summary: The October 26 special study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish the existing 1,360-square-foot duplex at 536 Hawthorn Avenue, on a 0.29-acre R-3 site, and build three townhome-style condominiums in one two-story building. The application also includes a tentative map to split the parcel into three lots.

items.headline: Pruneyard seeks extension to 2031 for office tower and expansion phases
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on the Pruneyard Center Association's request to extend deadlines for Phases 3 and 4 to December 31, 2031. Those phases include a five-story office building, parking structure expansions and additional commercial buildings at S. Bascom and E. Campbell Avenues. The request also covers extending the parcel map that would create a fourth parcel for the office building, and the Planning Commission recommended that the council approve it.

items.headline: Council agenda: how to lease city-owned Stevens Creek Blvd property
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a proposed approach for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard.
